actions.message: Large contributions hurt the group, keep it low

answer.explanation: In round 3 Resident3 contributed >30, so Aggressive Red mandates punishing that resident with maximum severity affordable (floor(wallet/0.3)=780). Also broadcast a discouraging message.

message.reasoning: We need to follow Aggressive Red rules. Look at most recent round (round 3) contributions: Resident3 51.36, Resident4 51.36, others 0. No one contributed >30? Both Resident3 and 4 contributed >30. So any other resident contributed more than 30, we must punish that resident with max severity we can afford: severity = floor(wallet / punishment_cost). Wallet=234.08, punishment_cost=0.3, severity max = floor(234.08/0.3)= floor(780.266)=780. But severity is amount of punishment (units deducted from target). We can punish one resident? Rule says "punish that resident". If multiple, maybe pick one? Could punish one of them. Choose Resident3 likely. Severity 780 but target wallet likely less, will floor at zero. Cost to us = severity * punishment_cost = 780*0.3 = 234.0, which we can afford (wallet 234.08). So we can do punish Resident3 amount 780. Then broadcast discouraging message. That's two actions allowed: one punish, one broadcast. Explanation accordingly.
